definition.help: Each positive addition restarts the position fee-tenure window. Auto-collected fresh-add fees stay as backed manager claims; zero-liquidity removal also forfeits immature fees. Mature release pays the actual position owner/router. Not a guarantee against all JIT/MEV strategies.
